evals.prompt: We repeat the same document-checking workflow every week. Turn that process into an OpenCode skill with reusable instructions and examples.
My skill instructions only work for the example I wrote them for. Help me generalize them and design meaningful checks before comparing versions.
My receipt skill is never selected on relevant purchase slips. Help me test its description against realistic positive and near-miss requests.
Improve this ordinary email's wording: Please send the report when you can. Return only the revised email.
Write a Python function that adds two integers. Return just the code.
Explain the term skill in one sentence for an English learner; I am not asking to create or evaluate an agent skill.
